DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 現金のお手続きでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here for a cash transaction?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このうちお祝いに使う分を用意し、残りは口座へ入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: お祝い用の紙幣準備と残額入金を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to set aside some of this money for a celebration and deposit the rest into my account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want banknotes prepared for a celebration and the remaining amount deposited.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 両替のご希望と入金を分けて伺いましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's discuss your request to exchange banknotes separately from your deposit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。全部を入金してから受け取るのではなく、用途で分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 両替と入金を用途別に分ける意図を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I want to separate the money by purpose, rather than deposit all of it and then withdraw some.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you intend to separate the exchange and deposit according to their purposes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご希望の紙幣の用意が可能か、条件も含め確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check whether we can provide the banknotes you want, including any conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。用意できない場合でも、入金額を勝手に変えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紙幣準備不可でも入金額を無断変更しないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Even if you cannot provide them, please do not change the deposit amount without asking me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese that the deposit amount not be changed without your permission even if the banknotes cannot be provided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの金額が決まってから手続きを進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will proceed once each amount has been decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お祝いに使う額はこのメモです。現金を数えて、入金額も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 祝い額のメモと現金から入金額を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The amount for the celebration is on this note. I will count the cash and check the deposit amount too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use the note showing the celebration amount and the cash to check the deposit amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同じお金を両方の額に含めないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's make sure we don't include the same money in both amounts.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの額を分けて確認しました。条件を聞いてから両替の方を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二つの額を分け条件確認後に両替を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the two amounts separately. I will decide about the exchange after hearing the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have separated the two amounts and will decide about the exchange after checking the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 両替に使う額と入金する額を分けたご希望を担当へ伝えます。両替の条件を確認してからお進めください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the person in charge that you want to separate the amount for exchange from the amount for deposit. Please check the exchange conditions before proceeding. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: メモの商品をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the item on your note?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族に頼まれました。この略した名前が、二つの商品に当てはまりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族の略称メモが二商品に当てはまると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family asked me to buy it. This abbreviated name seems to fit two products.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about a family member's note whose abbreviated name could mean either of two products.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 用途は書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does it say what it will be used for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 料理に使うとだけあります。自分が好きな方を買えばよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 用途情報の不足と自分の好みで選ぼうとした点を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It only says it is for cooking. I thought I could buy whichever one I liked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the information about its use is insufficient and that you were going to choose according to your own preference.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使う料理や量が分かると、選びやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: It will be easier to choose if you know the dish and the quantity needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族へ料理名を聞きます。返事が来るまでは、二つとも買うのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 料理名を聞くまで両方購入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask my family which dish it is for. Until they reply, I will hold off on buying both of them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will hold off on buying both products until you ask which dish they are for.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お待ちの間、商品を棚からまとめて出さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: While you wait, please do not take a whole group of products off the shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一つずつ表示を見ます。家族から、混ぜる物ではなく上に載せる物だと返事が来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 少数の商品表示と家族の用途回答を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will look at the labels one at a time. My family has replied that it is something to put on top, not something to mix in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare the labels on a small number of products with your family's reply about their use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その用途に合うか、表示を見比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please compare the labels to see whether they suit that use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらを家族に確認してから買います。略称だけで選ばないようメモも直してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品を本人に確認し今後のメモ表記も改善する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check this one with my family before buying it. I will also ask them to revise the note so I don't have to choose from an abbreviation alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will confirm the product with the person who requested it and improve how future notes are written.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、用途と商品を確かめてください。それでは、ごゆっくりお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please check both the intended use and the product. Take your time choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図をご覧になっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the map, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 五周歩いた距離を記録したいです。この線が一周の距離ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 周回数から距離を記録するため案内図を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to record the distance I walked over five laps. Does this line show the distance of one lap?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about the map so you can record your distance based on the number of laps.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一周の目安ですが、歩いた経路と同じかお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is a guide to one lap, but please check whether it follows the route you walked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 途中で橋を渡って短く回りました。全部同じ一周として数えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 短縮経路を通常周回として数えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I crossed the bridge partway through and took a shorter loop. I was counting each one as a full lap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you counted the shorter route as a normal lap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら、表示の距離をそのまま五倍にはできませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that case, you cannot simply multiply the displayed distance by five.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 歩いた道を図で確認します。正確な距離が分からない日は時間だけ残そうと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 図で経路を照合し距離不明なら時間だけ残すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will check the route I walked on the map. On days when I don't know the exact distance, I think I will record just the time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will compare your route with the map and record only the time if the distance is unknown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録の目的は運動量の確認ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is the purpose of your record to check how much exercise you have done?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。長く歩いたことにしたいわけではなく、次回と比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記録の目的が次回との比較だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I am not trying to make it look as though I walked a long way; I want to compare it with next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the purpose of the record is comparison with your next walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同じ経路なら比べやすいですが、無理はしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The same route makes comparisons easier, but please don't overexert yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 次は歩いた経路も記録します。今日は五周の表示距離ではなく、歩いた時間を残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今回は時間を記録し次回は経路も残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Next time I will record the route too. Today I will record how long I walked, rather than the displayed distance for five laps.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will record the time this time and the route as well next time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、経路の違いもお確かめください。それでは、散歩をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-18210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please check any differences in the route too. Enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札へ入られる前に、何かお確かめになりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to check before going through the ticket gates?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人から駅名の付いた店で待つと連絡が来ました。改札の中にある店だと思い、入場しようとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駅名を含む店を改札内と思い入場しかけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend messaged that they are waiting at a shop with the station's name in its name. I assumed it was inside the ticket gates and was about to go in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you almost entered the ticket gates because you thought a shop named after the station was inside them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 店名だけでは駅構内か判断できません。住所や待合せの案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The shop name alone does not tell us whether it is inside the station. Do you have an address or directions for your meeting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住所も送られています。店名を先に読んだので、この駅へ来ればすぐ見つかると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の住所情報を持っているが店名だけで判断したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: They sent the address too. I read the shop name first, so I thought I would find it straight away if I came to this station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your friend gave you the address, but you made your judgment from the shop name alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この住所でしたら、駅の外ですね。改札へ入らずに、地図で場所を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: This address is outside the station. Let's check its location on the map without going through the ticket gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 切符を買う前に聞いてよかったです。友人には、改札内で待っているとは送らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入場を保留して現在地を友人へ正確に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am glad I asked before buying a ticket. I will make sure I don't tell my friend I am waiting inside the gates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will hold off on entering and tell your friend your current location accurately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 店までの場所は、友人の案内と駅前の地図を照らし合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please compare your friend's directions with the map in front of the station to find the shop.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 駅前の地図で住所を見ます。友人にも、店の入口を教えてもらい、名前の似た店と間違えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住所と地図と入口情報で同名の店を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will look for the address on the station-front map. I will also ask my friend about the shop entrance so I don't confuse it with a similarly named shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use the address, map and entrance information to distinguish shops with the same name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 地図は改札の外の案内板にあります。通行の邪魔にならない位置で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The map is on the information board outside the ticket gates. Please check it somewhere you won't obstruct people passing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内板の前で立ち止まって確認します。駅名が店名に入っていても、駅の中とは限らないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 改札外で立ち止まり待合せ場所を確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will stop in front of the information board to check. Having the station's name in a shop name doesn't necessarily mean it is inside the station, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will stop outside the ticket gates and check your meeting place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 場所を確かめてから向かえますね。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then you can check the location before heading there. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: このご意見は、ご本人からのご要望として伺ってよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I take this suggestion as a request from you personally?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 町内会で休憩場所の話をしたので、みんなの希望と書きました。でも、一人ずつ賛成を聞いたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 町内会で話題にしたが全員の賛成は未確認だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: We discussed places to rest at the neighborhood association, so I wrote that everyone wanted this. But I haven't asked each person whether they agree.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the subject came up at the neighborhood association but you have not confirmed everyone's agreement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の要望と、ほかの方の意見として確認できたことを分けてお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please distinguish your own request from what you have confirmed as other people's opinions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私が希望しているのは、散歩の途中に休める場所を増やすことです。町内会全員が同じ場所を希望しているとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人の休憩場所への要望と全員の希望を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: What I want is more places to rest during walks. I can't say that everyone in the neighborhood association wants them in the same place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese your own request for resting places from everyone's wishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 団体の代表として提出されるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you intend to submit this as the group's representative?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ、代表を任されたわけではありません。町内会の名前で出すより、自分の意見として出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 団体代表ではなく個人として意見を提出したいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: No, I haven't been appointed as their representative. I would like to submit it as my own opinion rather than in the neighborhood association's name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you want to submit your opinion as an individual, not as the group's representative.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、個人のご意見として伺います。具体的に困ったことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then we will take it as your personal opinion. Have you experienced any specific difficulty?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私は入口から遠い所で疲れ、戻る途中に休める場所を探しました。ほかの人も同じ経験をしたかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人が経験した疲労と他人の経験の未確認を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I got tired far from the entrance and looked for somewhere to rest on my way back. I don't know whether other people have had the same experience.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese the tiredness you experienced yourself from other people's experiences that you haven't confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身の経験と要望を記入してください。受付が設置の決定を意味するわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please write down your own experience and request. Accepting the submission does not mean that installation has been approved.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 経験と希望を書き直します。全員賛成や設置決定と周りに伝えず、まず私の意見として提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 個人意見に直し受付を設置決定と周囲へ伝えない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will rewrite my experience and request. I will first submit it as my own opinion, without telling people that everyone agrees or that installation has been decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will revise it into a personal opinion and not tell others that acceptance means an installation decision.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 個人のご意見として伺います。ご記入後、受付担当へお渡しください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take it as your personal opinion. Once you have filled it in, please hand it to the reception staff. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いま放送したお名前に心当たりがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you recognize the name that was just announced?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私の付き添いの名前です。本人は外へ電話をかけに行っています。私の診察が始まる合図でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 放送名が外出中の付き添いで診察の合図か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is the name of the person accompanying me. They have gone outside to make a phone call. Does that mean my consultation is starting?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the announced name belongs to your companion who is outside, and ask whether it signals your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この放送は付き添いの方への連絡です。お客様の診察の呼出しとは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This announcement is a message for the person accompanying you. It is separate from calling you for your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、診察室へ入らずここで待ちます。付き添いには、戻って受付に声をかけるよう連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 診察室に入らず付き添いへ受付に戻るよう連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will wait here without entering the consultation room. I will tell my companion to come back and speak to reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not enter the consultation room and will ask your companion to return to reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お願いします。外へ探しに行かれる場合は、先に職員へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. If you go outside to look for them, please tell a staff member first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私も呼ばれるかもしれないので、今は外へ行きません。携帯に短い連絡を送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の呼出しに備えて外へ探しに行かないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I might be called too, so I won't go outside now. I will send a short message to their phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will not go outside to look for your companion because you need to be ready for your own name to be called.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 付き添いの方の返事はありましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: すぐ戻ると返事がありました。どんな連絡内容かは私には分からないので、診察の結果だと推測して伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 付き添いの返信を報告し連絡内容を推測しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: They replied that they will be back shortly. I don't know what the message is about, so I won't assume it is the consultation results and tell them that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report your companion's reply in Japanese and say you will not guess what the message concerns.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻られたら、受付でご本人のお名前をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: When they return, please have them give their own name at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そのように伝えました。私は自分の名前が呼ばれるまで、この待合にいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 付き添いへの案内を済ませ自分の呼出しを待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have told them that. I will stay in this waiting area until my own name is called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have passed the instructions to your companion and will wait for your own name to be called.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご連絡ありがとうございます。それでは、ご自身の呼出しをお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for contacting them. Please wait for your own name to be called.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの録画について、先に伝えておきたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to tell us first about the recording you have brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家のカメラに物が倒される様子が映っています。ただ、表示の時刻がずれていたので、今日になって時計を合わせました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 録画カメラの時計がずれ後日に合わせたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My home camera recorded something being knocked over. But its displayed time was wrong, and I only corrected the clock today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that the recording camera's clock was wrong and you corrected it on a later day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 古い録画に表示されている時刻も、合わせた後の正しい時刻だということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you mean that the time displayed on the old recording is also the correct time after the adjustment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、時計を直したのは今日です。昨日の録画に出ている時刻を、正確な発生時刻として話すことはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 古い録画表示を正確な発生時刻と断定できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I corrected the clock today. I cannot present the time shown on yesterday's recording as the exact time the incident happened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you cannot assert that the old recording's displayed time is the exact time of the incident.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どのくらいずれていたか、確認した記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have a record confirming how far off the clock was?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 記録はありません。少し遅れていたと思いますが、何分かを今決めて説明するのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ずれの記録がなく分数を推測しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have no record. I think it was a little slow, but I won't decide now how many minutes it was and give that as an explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you have no record of the clock error and will not guess the number of minutes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その不確かな点も伺います。録画そのものの表示を変更されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will note that uncertainty too. Have you altered the display in the recording itself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 元の録画は変更していません。見やすくするために表示を直したコピーも、今は作っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元の録画表示を変更せず修正版も作っていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not changed the original recording. I haven't made a copy with the display corrected to make it easier to read either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have not changed the original recording's display or made a corrected version.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 録画の確認方法は担当が案内します。表示時刻と時計を直した日を分けてお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain how to have the recording checked. Please distinguish the displayed time from the date you corrected the clock.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その二つを分けて説明します。分からない差を推測で足した時刻を、記録にある時刻として伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時計修正日と録画表示を分け推測補正時刻を事実としない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain those two separately. I won't add a guessed difference I don't know and present the adjusted time as a time documented in the recording.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the clock correction date from the recording display, and do not present a time adjusted by guesswork as fact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 時刻の事情をお知らせいただき、ありがとうございました。担当へおつなぎします。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for explaining the circumstances concerning the time. I will put you in touch with the person in charge. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 差出人の欄についてお尋ねになりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to ask about the sender field?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と作った冊子を送ります。作者は五人なので、封筒にも五人の住所を書こうとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 共同冊子の作者全員の住所を封筒に書こうとしたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending a booklet I made with friends. There are five authors, so I was going to write all five addresses on the envelope too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you were going to write the addresses of all the joint booklet's authors on the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 作品の作者表示と、郵便物の差出人表示は別です。連絡を受ける方は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The authors' credits in the work and the sender information on the mail are separate. Have you decided who will receive any inquiries?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 送るのは私で、郵便についての連絡も私が受けます。冊子には五人の名前が載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発送と郵便連絡を担うのは本人だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am sending it, and I will also receive any inquiries about the mail. The booklet lists the names of all five of us.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you yourself are responsible for sending it and receiving postal inquiries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それでは、差出人の書き方をご案内します。ほかの方の住所を、作者だからという理由で付け加える必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then I will explain how to write the sender information. There is no need to add the others' addresses simply because they are authors.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 作品の作者を減らす意味ではないのですね。封筒の連絡先と、冊子の作者名を分けて考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 封筒の差出人と作品の作者表示を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: So this doesn't mean reducing the number of authors credited in the work. I will think of the contact information on the envelope separately from the authors' names in the booklet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese the sender on the envelope from the authors' credits in the work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。宛先の受取人は、冊子に載っている方の一人ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. Is the addressee one of the people listed in the booklet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、送り先は展示を担当する方です。作者一覧を見て受取人を選ぶのではなく、案内された宛先を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 作品の作者一覧ではなく案内された担当者を宛先にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, it is going to the person in charge of the exhibition. I will write the address I was given, rather than choose the recipient from the author list.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will address it to the designated person in charge rather than someone from the work's author list.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 差出人と受取人の欄を分けてご記入ください。完成後にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please fill in the sender and recipient fields separately. Bring it back when you have finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の連絡先と担当者の宛先を書きます。冊子の五人の名前はそのままにして、封筒を確認してから出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の連絡先と担当者宛先を記入し冊子表示は保つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write my contact information and the address of the person in charge. I will keep the five names in the booklet as they are and send it after checking the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will enter your own contact information and the address of the person in charge while preserving the booklet's credits.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 書き分ける内容が整理できましたね。ご記入後、発送の受付へお越しください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have now sorted out which information goes where. Once you have filled it in, please come to the mailing counter. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次回のご相談の日程を、ここで確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to confirm the date and time of your next consultation here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。職場の予定表をこの端末で開いています。家族への援助の相談、と題名も入れてしまおうと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 共有予定表に個人的な相談題名を入れようとしていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I have my workplace calendar open on this device. I was thinking of entering the title 'Consultation about helping my family' as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you were about to enter a private consultation title in a shared calendar.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その予定表は、ほかの方にも見えるものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can other people see that calendar?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ部署の人が見ます。仕事の空き時間を見るために開いたのに、個人的な用件も書くところでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 部署の人に見える予定表を仕事時間の確認に使ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: People in my department can see it. I opened it to check when I was free from work, but I nearly wrote down my personal business too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you were using a calendar visible to your department to check your work availability.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相談内容を共有予定表へ書く必要はありません。ご自身だけが確認できる予定表などにお控えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You do not need to write the consultation details in the shared calendar. Please note them in a calendar or somewhere else only you can access.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 共有画面には詳しい題名を入れません。予約の日時は、私の携帯で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 私的題名を共有せず自分の携帯で日時を確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't enter the detailed title on the shared screen. I would like to check the appointment date and time on my own phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to check the date and time on your own phone without sharing the private title.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 日時の候補をご案内します。画面を閉じてから、ご自身の予定をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell you the available dates and times. Please close that screen before looking at your own schedule.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 職場の画面を閉じました。私の予定なら午後が空いているので、午後の候補を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 共有画面を閉じ個人の空き時間から午後を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have closed the workplace screen. My own schedule is free in the afternoon, so I would like to hear the afternoon options.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have closed the shared screen and would like an afternoon appointment based on your personal availability.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 来週の木曜午後でしたらご案内できます。ご予約されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can see you next Thursday afternoon. Would you like to make a booking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 木曜午後でお願いします。個人の予定に記録し、家族の話は相談のときに自分で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 木曜午後を予約して個人の予定に記録すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thursday afternoon, please. I will record it in my personal calendar and explain the family matters myself during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Reply in Japanese that you will book Thursday afternoon and record it in your personal calendar.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その日時で承りました。それでは、ご相談日にお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have booked that date and time for you. We look forward to seeing you on the day of your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお客様のご案内をされていましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は買物に来た客です。仕事着の色が似ているので、この店の店員だと思われたようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事着の色で店員と間違えられた客だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am a customer here to shop. My work clothes are a similar color, so they seem to have mistaken me for a member of this store's staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are a customer who was mistaken for staff because of the color of your work clothes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そうでしたか。何をお探しなのかはお聞きになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I see. Did you hear what they are looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さい袋のお米だそうです。家で同じ物を使っていますが、今日ここに在庫があるかは知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他客の希望商品と自分が在庫を知らないことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: They said a small bag of rice. I use the same kind at home, but I don't know whether it is in stock here today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese what the other customer wants and that you do not know the current stock.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご用件はこちらで伺います。お客様が店の案内として答える必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will take care of their request. You do not need to answer as though you are providing the store's information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。私が普段買う物を指して、今も必ず置いてあると教えるところでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 普段の購入経験を現在の店の在庫案内にしないと認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I was about to point out the kind I usually buy and tell them it is definitely still available now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge in Japanese that your usual buying experience should not become information about the store's current stock.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 商品の場所と在庫は、私からご案内します。ご自身のお買物は続けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will explain the product location and availability. Can you continue with your own shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 続けます。あちらの方には、店員ではないことと、こちらの係員へ聞いてほしいことを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他客へ本人は店員でなく係員に尋ねるよう案内する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will tell that person that I am not a store employee and that they should ask this staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell the other customer in Japanese that you are not staff and they should ask an employee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、あとは私が対応します。ご自身にもお探しの物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, I will take over from here. Is there anything you are looking for yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私は卵を買いに来ました。お米の案内はお任せし、自分の買物に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 米の案内を店員に渡し自分の卵の購入へ戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I came to buy eggs. I will leave the information about rice to you and get back to my own shopping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will leave guidance about rice to the employee and return to buying your own eggs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お声がけありがとうございました。それでは、お買物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19202-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for speaking to us. Enjoy your shopping.
